This place is only surviving on legacy. The owner Mr Nilesh Buthello is extremely unscrupulous and out to make a quick buck from unsuspecting customers.

He gave me a quotation for my Audi A6 (attached with this review) for my air suspension, coolant filter and allied accessories for 1.3 lacs. Never ever give your car here unless you want to get scammed. Always check with genuine parts dealers the rates before you give a mechanic.
